# DAGChain { #dyf.DAGChain }

```python
DAGChain(indices, coherence, diversity_range)
```

A single DAG chain representing a hierarchical path.

Chains flow from general concepts (high neighbor diversity) to
specific concepts (low neighbor diversity).

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name            | Type                                     | Description                                                 |
|-----------------|------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|
| indices         | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) | Point indices in chain order (general → specific)           |
| coherence       | [float](`float`)                         | Average pairwise similarity within chain (higher = tighter) |
| diversity_range | [float](`float`)                         | Difference between first and last diversity scores          |
